results.title: About IJCAI | IJCAI
highlights: Starting with 2016, IJCAI conferences are held annually. IJCAI-24 in Jeju, South Korea, IJCAI-25 Montreal, Canada and IJCAI-ECAI-26 in Bremen, Germany. For more information on the IJCAI conference rotational pattern and bidding requirements, please contact IJCAI's Executive Director and Secretary. The next call for bids will be open for the 2027 and 2028 conferences will be issued in late 2023. The call for IJCAI-2027 will be open to AI scientific societies from anywhere in the world. IJCAI shall not consider bid inquiries or submissions from congress centers, professional conference organizers or governmental organizations.

results.title: Future Conferences | IJCAI
highlights: Pursuant to IJCAI By-laws, agreements between IJCAI and other international AI Organizations and local arrangements' contracts, IJCAI Conferences are solely run by the Conference Committee, which consists of the Conference Chair (Chairperson), Program Chair, Local Arrangements Committee Chair, IJCAI Executive Secretary&Director and IJCAI Secretary-Treasurer. The third IJCAI-ECAI-26 will be held in Bremen, Germany from August 15th until August 21st, 2026. Hosts of IJCAI-2027 and IJCAI-2028 will be announced at preceding conferences. We look forward to seeing you there!

results.title: Venues – IJCAI 2026
highlights:
### Main Conference: Congress Centrum Bremen
...
The main IJCAI-ECAI 2026 conference will take place from 18 to 21 August 2026 at the Congress Centrum Bremen (https://congress-bremen.com/en/) (CCB), a centrally located congress venue in the heart of Bremen. Inside, the congress building offers postmodern conference spaces with generous natural light for plenary talks, technical sessions and networking opportunities. Directly connected to the CCB, Hall 4 will serve as the main area for the exhibition, poster sessions and coffee breaks, creating a central meeting point for participants throughout the conference.The CCB is only a few steps from Bremen Central Station, with a direct tram connection to Bremen Airport and Main Station and parking available on Bürgerweide, directly in front of the congress building. Located next to Bürgerpark and within walking distance of the historic city centre, the venue is easy to reach by public transport and offers convenient access to the city centre.The Maritim Hotel Bremen is directly connected to the Congress Centrum, and further hotel options are close by.

From 15 to 21 August 2026, Bremen will become a hub for international AI research: the International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI), one of the world’s leading conferences on artificial intelligence, will bring together more than 3,000 experts from academia and industry. The focus will be on the latest research findings and applications – ranging from human-centred AI and robotics to medicine and key technologies. The main programme will take place from 18 to 21 August at the Congress Centrum Bremen. An accompanying industry exhibition at MESSE BREMEN will bridge the gap between research and practical application.Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

results.title: Bremen Officially Confirmed as Host City for IJCAI-ECAI 2026 | EN
results.author: U Bremen Research Alliance
highlights:
At the close of this year’s International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI), held from August 11–17, 2025 in Montreal, Canada, and August 29–31, 2025 in Guangzhou, China, the official announcement was made: The next edition of the prestigious conference – IJCAI-ECAI 2026 – will take place in Bremen from August 15 to 21, 2026. Around 3,500 to 4,000 AI experts from around the globe are expected to gather in the Hanseatic city during the conference week.
...
The conference will kick off with workshops and tutorials from August 15 to 17, 2026 at the University of Bremen. The main conference will begin on August 18, 2026, and take place at the Bremen Exhibition Center. Simultaneously, an exhibition will feature sponsors along with further industry partners, startups, and scientific institutions.
...
Local Arrangements Committee (LAC) Chair Prof. Dr.-Ing. Tanja Schultz (University of Bremen) and Co-Chair Dr.-Ing. Monika Michaelis (U Bremen Research Alliance) present Bremen as the host city for IJCAI-ECAI 2026 during IJCAI 2025 in Montreal. © U Bremen Research
...
